entries.text: Well, travelers tell me there's a bunch of crazies up north called the Vipers. Another group of yahoos out east called the Khans. Neither one of them likely to invite you to supper as anything but the main course, if you know what I mean.

entries.text: Well, ya got the Hub southwest. Don't go south, though. That'd be Necropolis; the, uh . . . climate's bad there, rain or shine. If you understand what I'm saying.
Well, thanks for the information. Can I ask you a few more questions?

entries.text: Well, Junktown's not much, but it's home. Mostly we trade with people or let 'em forget their troubles for a bit. Of course, we have our share of problems.

entries.text: From outside, we've had the occasional to-do with the Khans. But they've been pretty quiet lately. Inside, trouble's been from the Skulz. And I hear of some strange things happening down by the Hub, but they haven't affected us yet, knock on my mother-in-law's head.

entries.text: Oh, we got tons to do. The Skum Pitt's on the east side, by the entrance. Great drinkin' place. Gizmo's is near there. And if you're hurtin', Doc Morbid's your man.

entries.text: Oh, you obviously have me confused with someone who has to take your lip. Why don't you come back when your mama teaches you some manners.

entries.text: Well that's a damn fine coincidence! That's what this store's here for! We got about everything you can need. Let me show you some things over here . . .

entries.text: You bet. May not be as big as some in the Hub, but people usually find what they're looking for. Take a look around . . .

entries.text: You have to wear a recorder and tape Gizmo confessing, or plant this wire tap in his office. Either way, and we got him.

entries.text: Well Vinnie, he's one of the problem children. He leads a group of punks called the Skulz. Still, they pay rent, and they haven't bothered anyone too much.

entries.text: Well, the Khans are a bunch of bullies who live outside to the east. They've been trying to take over Junktown for as long as I can remember, but they never make it past the gates.

entries.text: Ah, Gizmo's is the casino by the entrance. I'm surprised you didn't notice it on your way in. You can usually smell the place for miles. But hey, it brings in the tourists.

entries.text: Well, there are two kinds, the Khans and the Vipers. We usually don't get trouble from the Vipers, and a few of them actually pass through town. The Khans, though, they're a mean bunch. They think they can conquer the world, or some such crap.

entries.text: You gain 600 experience points for your part in the defeat of Killian. Junktown will never be the same.

entries.text: You gain 500 experience points for securing Gizmo's confession.

entries.text: I'm here to take you in, Gizmo. This time, I've got the proof I need.
entries.source_text: I'm here to take you in, Gizmo. This time, I've got the proof I need.

entries.text: What do you know about this Gizmo character?
entries.source_text: What do you know about this Gizmo character?

entries.text: Okay.
entries.source_text: Okay.

entries.text: Yeah, he's dangerous. I'm here to kill you for him.
entries.source_text: Yeah, he's dangerous. I'm here to kill you for him.

entries.text: I'll say . . . that fat slob just tried to hire me to kill you. Why don't you do something about him?
entries.source_text:

entries.text: I'll take a shotgun and shells.

entries.text: I'll take a doctor's medical kit.

entries.text: I'll take all the stimpaks you can spare.

entries.text: No thanks. Knowing that Gizmo's going to get his due is thanks enough.
entries.source_text: No thanks. Knowing that Gizmo's going to get his due is thanks enough.

entries.text: I'd like to take a look at traveling gear.
entries.source_text: I'd like to take a look at traveling gear.

entries.text: I'll look around on my own, thanks.
entries.source_text: I'll look around on my own, thanks.

entries.text: Never mind. Thanks.
entries.source_text: Never mind. Thanks.

entries.text: You moved against Gizmo without evidence. Y'know, he wasn't on the up-and-up, but neither are you. Go see Lars.

entries.text: Nope, I've never heard of anything like that.

entries.text: Ohhh . . . I really couldn't tell ya.

entries.text: Gizmo owns the casino over on the east side. Named it after himself. Be very careful around him.
entries.source_text:
Gizmo owns the casino over on the east side. Named it after himself.
 Be very careful around him.

entries.text: Well, that's me. Where have you been?
entries.source_text: Well, that's me. Where have you been?

entries.text: Oh, Lars heads up the guards here. He's a good guy. Pretty trustworthy.
entries.source_text:
Oh, Lars heads up the guards here. He's a good guy.
 Pretty trustworthy.

entries.text: Well Vinnie, he's one of the problem children. He leads a group of punks called the Skulz. Still, they pay the rent, and they haven't bothered anyone too much.
entries.source_text:
Well Vinnie, he's one of the problem children. He leads a group
 of punks called the Skulz. Still, they pay the rent, and they haven't bothered
 anyone too much.

entries.text: Well, Doc owns a little place in the middle of the town. Does a nice patch job if you need it. Fairly reasonable prices.
entries.source_text:
Well, Doc owns a little place in the middle of the town. Does
 a nice patch job if you need it. Fairly reasonable prices.

entries.text: The Skulz are a bunch of punks who work for Gizmo. They don't cause that much trouble, but me and Lars keep an eye on them.
entries.source_text:
The Skulz are a bunch of punks who work for Gizmo. They don't cause
 that much trouble, but me and Lars keep an eye on them.

entries.text: Well, the Khans are a bunch of bullies who live outside to the east. They've been trying to take over Junktown for as long as I can remember, but they never make it past the gates.
entries.source_text:

entries.text: The Vipers are a crazy bunch from up north. They worship snakes, or something.
entries.source_text:
The Vipers are a crazy bunch from up north. They worship snakes, or
 something.

entries.text: That's my store. You need it, I got it.
entries.source_text: That's my store. You need it, I got it.

entries.text: Great place to get a cheap room. Not too dirty, either. But don't mess with the owner, Marcelles, she'll pull your arms out if you smart off to her.
entries.source_text:
Great place to get a cheap room. Not too dirty, either. But don't
 mess with the owner, Marcelles, she'll pull your arms out if you smart
 off to her.

entries.text: Ah, Gizmo's is the casino by the entrance. I'm surprised you didn't notice it on your way in. You can usually smell the place for miles. But hey, it brings in the tourists.
entries.source_text:

 hey, it brings in the tourists.

entries.text: That's our resident bar. The food's okay, but the beer's great. The owner, Neal, takes no lip, not even from some of the Raiders that come in.
entries.source_text:
That's our resident bar. The food's okay, but the beer's great.
 The owner, Neal, takes no lip, not even from some of the Raiders that come in.

entries.text: Not much to say. Doc Morbid's pretty pissed 'cause their prices are lower for medical stuff. They're on the west side.
entries.source_text:

entries.text: The Death Claw? Oh, that's a bedtime story. Drinks blood and howls at the full moon. Yeah, right.
entries.source_text:
The Death Claw? Oh, that's a bedtime story. Drinks blood and howls
 at the full moon. Yeah, right.

entries.text: Well, the Hub's the main place for trade. Anything you don't find here you'll probably find in the Hub. Not sure how safe it is nowadays, with all those strange things going on.
entries.source_text:

entries.text: Shady Sands? That's a little place up to the north. I'd like to do more trading with them.
entries.source_text:

entries.text: That city's death. I sent two patrols down there and neither one of them returned.
entries.source_text:
That city's death. I sent two patrols
 down there and neither one of them returned.

entries.text: Well, there are two kinds, the Khans and the Vipers. We usually don't get trouble from the Vipers, and a few of them actually pass through town. The Khans, though, they're a mean bunch. They think they can conquer the world, or some such crap.
entries.source_text:

 They think they can conquer the world, or some such crap.

entries.text: Where've you been for the last 100 years? In a closet? My father used to tell me stories about the War. His father was a soldier before starting Junktown.

entries.text: Well, there're some rumors coming up from the Hub. Caravans disappearing, people being butchered, even some talk of big green monsters who eat human flesh. All sorts of weird stuff.
